abilities.name: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Let's Go, Eevee!
Due to the danger that this synthetic Pokémon may go on a rampage
it wears a control mask to restrain its power.
A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission
it went berserk during an experiment
There's danger of its going on a rampage
so its true power is sealed away beneath its control mask.
Let's Go, Pikachu! and Let's Go, Eevee!
Able to conceal itself in shadows
so its very existence was the stuff of myth.
It lurks in the shadows of others
copying their movements and powers. This Pokémon is craven and cowering.
It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves
it becomes stronger than those it's imitating.
It sinks into the shadows of people and Pokémon
where it can understand their feelings and copy their capabilities.
